notes: Prices are indicative list prices for planning and sales conversations. The head of growth sets final prices.
Fees are Pith management fees. Media, creator, venue, wire, platform and message fees pass through at cost with no mark-up.
Every package includes Brand package A (brand-to-brain, one-off) and Analytics Measure (monthly). No client work starts until the client brain is live.
FX rates are planning assumptions as of the as_of date. Refresh them before a written quote.
Market and industry rules are planning summaries, not legal advice. A local lawyer confirms each market before the first campaign.

launch.name: Launch
launch.for: First 6 months in a market. Prove the core channels.

growth.name: Growth
growth.for: Proven fit. Add channels, more markets and better attribution.

scale.name: Scale
scale.for: Multi-market or category leader. Full mix with orchestration.

industries.name: SaaS and technology
industries.examples: Software, cloud, cybersecurity, data and AI products
industries.goal: Pipeline: MQL to SQL to closed-won, and lower CAC

industries.name: Professional and financial services
industries.examples: Consulting, legal, accounting, B2B fintech, insurance and wealth firms
industries.goal: Trust and authority, then qualified enquiries from senior buyers

regulated.name: Financial promotions review
regulated.why: Financial promotions need sign-off: UK FCA s21 approver, Singapore MAS, US SEC/FINRA rules, each GCC regulator (for example DFSA, CBUAE, SAMA), EU MiFID and national rules.

industries.name: Industrial, manufacturing and logistics
industries.examples: Manufacturers, engineering, construction suppliers, freight and logistics
industries.goal: Distributor and buyer enquiries, trade show pipeline

industries.name: E-commerce and DTC
industries.examples: Fashion, beauty, home, consumer electronics, food and drink brands online
industries.goal: Revenue at a target ROAS, repeat purchase and lifetime value

industries.name: Hospitality, travel and food and drink
industries.examples: Hotels, restaurants, cafes, attractions, tour operators, airlines
industries.goal: Direct bookings and covers, reviews, repeat visits

industries.name: Real estate and property
industries.examples: Developers, off-plan launches, estate agents, serviced apartments
industries.goal: Qualified buyer and tenant leads, viewings booked, launch sell-through

regulated.name: Property advertising checks
regulated.why: Housing is a special ad category on Meta and Google in the US and Canada (no age, gender or ZIP targeting). Dubai property ads need a Trakheesi permit. UK listings must show material information. Confirm each rule with a local lawyer.

industries.name: Health, wellness and clinics
industries.examples: Private clinics, dental, aesthetics, fitness, supplements, health apps
industries.goal: Booked appointments and members, with zero claim breaches

regulated.name: Health claims review
regulated.why: No disease or cure claims without proof. UK MHRA and CAP Code, Singapore HSA, US FDA and FTC, UAE health authority ad permits (DoH, DHA, MOHAP), EU national rules. Weight loss and cosmetic ads: no under-18s.

industries.name: Education and edtech
industries.examples: Universities, private schools, language schools, online courses, edtech apps
industries.goal: Applications and enrolments per intake, at a target cost per enrolment

regulated.name: Education advertising checks
regulated.why: Claims about outcomes and rankings need proof. Singapore private schools: CPE rules. UAE: KHDA and ADEK rules. Ads to minors are restricted everywhere and banned on profiling in the EU.
